race.comment: AMOURETTE (1) is worth following up after running to what looks a smart one in an Open over the mile at Doomben in Saturday company. She now eases to a more suitable assignment and should be at her top fourth-up. FEARLESS WIN (5) comes through the same Doomben race and had excuses after knuckling at the start and being forced wide, so she is capable of closing the gap. SPIRIT OF TORQUE (2) was third there after covering ground and had won a Mdn at Doomben by 4L the run prior. Not dismissing.  ALTO LUNA (6) is the fresh improver after a well-backed Beaudesert Mdn win on soft ground. Backs up quickly into this and is among the chances.
